review_scope: Every unit-wordlist page and headword/unit grouping visually checked. Separate alphabetical, Level II and proper-name sections are retained as evidence and not double-counted. Individual IPA, gloss, typography and variant annotations have not been transcribed.

source_legend.star_meaning: Recognition and listening comprehension required; spelling not required, according to this book legend. Individual star flags are not transcribed. This is not the national standard level-2 marker.
source_legend.parenthesized_numbers: Printed body page where this entry first occurs; retained when an unambiguous native page-number association exists.
source_legend.scope_exclusions: Instruction, grammar-explanation, study-skills and Project words are excluded by the source legend; this is not an exhaustive inventory of all book tokens.
